summary: Complete testing of CRM Contacts → Clients conversion and Client management features. All 9 requested features verified and working correctly. Backend: 13/13 tests passed. Frontend: All UI flows verified via Playwright. Fixed 1 backend bug (empty code duplicate check).
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM → Clients conversion fully working. Existing clients: Cocinas Pérez S.L. (activo, CLI001), Juan García (potencial, converted from CRM). Commercial user COMSA has 1 shop assigned (TIENDA SALAMANCA).

crm_convert_to_client_button.details: Button 'Convertir a Cliente Potencial' (UserCheck icon, orange) appears for non-converted contacts. Uses data-testid='convert-contact-{id}'.

crm_converted_label.details: Converted contacts show 'CONVERTIDO' label (emerald/green) and status changes to 'Cliente'.

clients_list_colors.details: Clients tab shows 🟠 POTENCIAL (orange) and 🟢 ACTIVO (green) labels. Stats cards show Total/Potenciales/Activos counts.

clients_filter_by_type.details: Filter dropdown with options: Todos, 🟠 Potenciales, 🟢 Activos. Also segment filter available.

clients_activate_button.details: Green checkmark button visible for POTENCIAL clients without code. Clicking opens modal to assign code.

clients_activate_with_code.details: POST /api/clients/{id}/activate assigns code, changes tipo to 'activo', sets convertidoAt timestamp.

clients_link_user_button.details: Link user button (person icon) visible for all clients. POST /api/clients/{id}/link-user links client to user.

user_inherits_client_discount.details: User form shows 'VINCULAR A CLIENTE' dropdown with helper text 'El usuario heredará el descuento del cliente vinculado'. When client selected, commercialDiscount is updated.

commercial_mis_tiendas_button.details: Commercial users (isRepresentative=true, isAdmin=false) see 'MIS TIENDAS' button in sidebar. Opens modal showing assigned shops, projects, and opportunities.

ui_verification.crm_contacts_page: Shows contacts with status, convert button for non-converted, CONVERTIDO label for converted
ui_verification.clients_tab: Shows clients with tipo colors, stats cards, filter dropdowns, action buttons (Activar, Vincular Usuario)
ui_verification.user_form: Shows 'Vincular a Cliente' dropdown with discount inheritance helper text
ui_verification.commercial_sidebar: Shows 'MIS TIENDAS' button for commercial users (not admin)
ui_verification.mis_tiendas_modal: Shows summary cards, assigned shops list, projects section, opportunities section

bug_fixed.issue: create_client endpoint was checking for duplicate codes even when code was empty, preventing creation of potential clients
bug_fixed.fix: Added check 'if client.codigo and client.codigo.strip()' before duplicate check
